zh.summary: 從工作角色找出該問誰、要釐清什麼，再用中立問題與具體事件建立可追溯的需求紀錄。
objectives: 依工作責任辨識使用者、規則負責人、受影響者與維運角色。
將預設解法的提問改成可追問具體事件的訪談問題。
分開記錄供述、解釋、衝突與待確認決定。

readingGuide.goal: 依工作責任辨識使用者、規則負責人、受影響者與維運角色。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 沿用 problem.md、文字編輯器及本課合成角色表；不需要真人或真實業務資料。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 problem.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 新增角色表、三題訪談問題及一筆標明合成來源的需求候選。

sections.heading: 先找工作責任，再找職稱
paragraphs: 角色是人在某項任務中的責任，不一定對應一個職稱。同一人可能早上填寫、下午複核；主管也可能偶爾代班。若只寫「一般使用者與管理員」，容易漏掉誰定義必填規則、誰接到缺件通知，以及誰在系統故障時處理資料。
利害關係人是會影響這項服務、或受到它影響的人。直接操作介面的人只是其中一部分。本課的合成收件情境還包括提供資料者、複核者、規則負責人與維運者；列出角色是為了找到需要釐清的問題，並不自動授予資料存取權。

sections.heading: 像確認一份包裹由誰交接
paragraphs: 收包裹的人知道今天如何核對，寄件者知道缺漏從哪裡發生，值班主管知道例外由誰決定，維修人員知道設備壞掉如何復原。只問其中一人，很難拼出完整交接。軟體需求也需要看不同位置的工作。
但不必把所有人都邀來問同一套問題。先寫清楚你不知道什麼，再選擇最可能提供具體證據的角色。GOV.UK 的研究規劃指南建議將未有依據的意見轉為研究問題，並依問題選擇研究對象與方法。

sections.heading: 用角色表找出證據缺口
paragraphs: 下面是教學用角色表，不是正式組織圖或權限矩陣。「複核者想看全部」只表示一個待釐清要求；能否存取哪些資料，仍需在 M06 形成授權規則。
若收件人員說文件類型可空白，規則負責人說必填，先記下適用情境與衝突。請雙方各舉近期可公開的例子，確認是不同案件、不同階段，還是規則尚未定案。不要讓 Agent 選擇它覺得合理的一方。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜同一任務的不同觀點
rows: 請用合成資料帶我走一次最近這類缺件的處理步驟。
你接手時先確認哪些事情？遇到例外時怎麼處理？
必要條件及例外的決定權
哪些情況需要文件類型？規則由誰確認、在哪裡留下版本？
程式無法啟動時，由誰接手？現有資料要如何處理？
哪些資訊最難準備？你如何知道下一步要補什麼？

sections.heading: 詢問事件，讓對方說出做法
paragraphs: 訪談的用途是理解情境與原因。GOV.UK 的深度訪談指南建議使用開放、中立的問題，聚焦故事與具體例子，再用追問釐清；本課將這個方法縮成紙上練習，不要求直接接觸真人或收集業務資料。
「如果 AI 自動填完，你一定更快吧？」已把解法與結論放進問題。可改問：「上一次填寫時，哪一步需要離開表單找資訊？」再追問「從哪裡找、找不到會怎麼做、最後由誰決定可以交接」。對方說「很麻煩」時，請他描述一次發生過程，不急著用你自己的原因代替。
若未來安排真人訪談，需先說明目的、資料用途與紀錄方式，取得相應同意，避免請對方展示真實個資或機密文件。可先請同儕試讀題目，檢查是否難懂或帶有預設答案。

sections.heading: 讓紀錄保留來源與不確定性
paragraphs: 假設合成訪談卡寫著：「我會把空白欄位圈起來，再請對方補。」可觀察的供述是圈欄位與補件；「系統只要變紅色就足夠」是設計者推論，仍要以任務試用驗證。把兩者分欄，之後才能知道哪個要求有證據、哪個是試做方向。
角色表也應容納少數情境與協助需求，例如鍵盤操作、低頻使用或代班交接。少數人提出的障礙不會因票數少而自動失效。記錄目前還沒有訪問的角色及問題，讓下一輪研究有方向。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜把一段訪談帶到可確認的需求
blocks.description: 箭頭表示分析與確認順序；每一步保留來源，不表示一次訪談足以定案。

items.title: 供述／事件
items.body: 保留角色、情境與可公開例子；本課全部使用合成卡。

items.title: 解釋與缺口
items.body: 標示設計者推論、衝突及尚未接觸的角色。

items.title: 需求候選
items.body: 提出想改善的工作結果與適用條件。

items.title: 確認與驗證
items.body: 請適當角色確認規則，再以案例或任務試用檢查解法。

sections.heading: 把角色與待確認事項接回 problem.md
paragraphs: 下面紀錄可以接在 M03-01 的問題陳述後。來源欄可填「合成卡 SYN-I01」，不應虛構真人姓名或研究日期。真正訪談時，公開摘要與受控原始記錄分開，並依授權與保存安排處理。
常見誤解是「主管一句話就代表所有使用者」。主管可以決定範圍與資源，實際操作者仍能提供不同的工作證據。遇到衝突時留下決策負責角色與下一步，不把票數、職位或模型回答當作已完成的需求分析。

blocks.heading: 角色與訪談紀錄範例
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 problem.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 角色與訪談（合成）
問題：缺件時誰提供明確的補件資訊？
角色：收件、複核、提供資料者、規則負責人、維運
來源：合成卡 SYN-I01；沒有真人訪談
供述：收件者圈出空白欄位，再請對方補
推論：具體欄位提示可能有幫助，尚待任務測試
衝突：空白文件類型在何種階段可交接，尚未定案
確認者：教學情境中的規則負責角色
下一步：用缺件與補齊兩個案例確認交接條件

exercise.environment: 沿用 problem.md、文字編輯器及本課合成角色表；不需要真人或真實業務資料。
steps: 為共同案例列出五種工作責任，寫下各角色最能釐清的一個問題。
將「你希望 AI 自動處理嗎」改成收件、複核、管理者各一題中立問題，並加入具體事件追問。
用合成回答寫一列供述、推論、需求候選與待確認決定，再請同儕指出哪個仍沒有證據。
exercise.expected: problem.md 新增角色表、三題訪談問題及一筆標明合成來源的需求候選。
exercise.check: 問題不預設工具；紀錄能區分角色供述、設計者推論與確認者；沒有把猜測當成實際研究。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成標記與修訂紀錄；若誤填真人姓名或非公開例子，移除後改用代號與合成情境。

en.summary: Use work responsibilities to decide whom to ask and what to clarify, then build traceable requirements records with neutral questions and concrete events.
objectives: Identify users, rule owners, affected parties and operations roles through their responsibilities.
Replace questions that assume a solution with questions about concrete events.
Record accounts, interpretations, conflicts and pending decisions separately.

readingGuide.goal: Identify users, rule owners, affected parties and operations roles through their responsibilities.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Use problem.md, a text editor and the synthetic role table. No actual participants or business data are required.
readingGuide.route: Read the scenario and principles, compare examples, then expand problem.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A role table, three interview questions and one proposed requirement with a synthetic source in problem.md.

sections.heading: Identify Responsibilities Before Job Titles
paragraphs: A role describes responsibility in a task and need not match a job title. One person may enter data in the morning and review it later; a supervisor may occasionally cover a shift. “User and administrator” can overlook who defines required fields, receives missing-information notices or handles data during failures.

Stakeholders influence or are affected by the service. Direct interface users are only some of them. This synthetic intake scenario also includes submitters, reviewers, rule owners and operations staff. Listing roles helps identify questions; it grants no data access.

sections.heading: Identify Everyone Involved in a Parcel Handoff
paragraphs: The recipient knows today’s checking procedure, the sender knows where omissions arise, the shift supervisor knows who decides exceptions, and maintenance staff know how to recover failed equipment. Asking only one person may leave gaps in the handoff. Software requirements likewise need evidence from different work positions.

You need not ask everyone the same questions. First state what is unknown, then choose roles likely to provide concrete evidence. GOV.UK’s research-planning guidance recommends turning unsupported opinions into research questions and choosing participants and methods around them.

sections.heading: Use a Role Table to Find Evidence Gaps
paragraphs: This is a teaching role table, not an official organization chart or permissions matrix. “The reviewer wants to see everything” is a request to clarify; M06 will turn confirmed access needs into authorization rules.

If an intake worker says document type may be blank but the rule owner says it is required, record the contexts and conflict. Ask each for a recent shareable example to determine whether cases or stages differ, or the rule is undecided. Do not let an agent choose whichever view seems reasonable.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Different Views of One Task
rows: How omissions are found and handled.
Use synthetic data to walk me through a recent example of handling this kind of omission.
Handoff conditions and reasons for return.
What do you check first when taking over? How do you handle exceptions?
Required conditions and authority over exceptions.
When is document type needed? Who confirms the rule and where is its version kept?
Who takes over if the program will not start? What happens to existing data?
Which information is hardest to prepare? How do you know what to provide next?

sections.heading: Ask About Events and Let People Explain Their Actions
paragraphs: Interviews help explain circumstances and reasons. GOV.UK’s in-depth interview guidance recommends open, neutral questions focused on stories and specific examples, followed by clarifying questions. This course reduces the method to a tabletop exercise without actual participants or business-data collection.

“If AI filled everything in, you would be faster, right?” already assumes both solution and outcome. Ask instead, “During your last entry, where did you leave the form to find information?” Then ask where they looked, what happened if it was unavailable and who finally decided handoff was possible. When someone says “it was troublesome,” ask for the sequence of events before supplying your own explanation.

For future interviews with actual participants, explain purpose, data use and recording, obtain appropriate consent, and avoid asking for real personal or confidential documents. Have peers try the questions first to identify confusing wording or assumed answers.

sections.heading: Retain Sources and Uncertainty in the Record
paragraphs: Suppose a synthetic interview card says, “I circle blank fields and ask the person to fill them in.” Circling and requesting corrections are the reported actions. “Making the system red will be enough” is a designer’s inference requiring task testing. Separate them so you can distinguish evidence-backed needs from designs to try.

Include less common situations and support needs, such as keyboard operation, infrequent use and shift cover. A barrier raised by fewer people does not disappear because it gets fewer votes. Record roles and questions not yet researched to guide the next round.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From an Interview Account to a Confirmable Requirement
blocks.description: The sequence represents analysis and confirmation. Retain sources at each step; one interview does not necessarily settle a requirement.

items.title: Account / event
items.body: Keep role, context and shareable examples. This course uses only synthetic cards.

items.title: Interpretation and gaps
items.body: Label designer inferences, conflicts and roles not yet consulted.

items.title: Proposed requirement
items.body: Describe the work outcome to improve and its applicable conditions.

items.title: Confirmation and verification
items.body: Ask the appropriate role to confirm rules, then check solutions through cases or task testing.

sections.heading: Bring Roles and Pending Decisions Back to problem.md
paragraphs: Append this record to the M03-01 statement. A source can be “synthetic card SYN-I01”; do not invent participant names or research dates. In actual interviews, keep public summaries separate from controlled raw records and follow authorization and retention arrangements.

A common mistake is assuming one supervisor’s statement represents every user. Supervisors can decide scope and resources; operators can still provide different work evidence. Preserve the decision-owning role and next step when views conflict, rather than treating votes, seniority or a model answer as completed analysis.

blocks.heading: Role and Interview Record
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the question, five roles, synthetic source SYN-I01 with no actual interview, reported action, untested interpretation, unresolved document-type rule, confirming role and two next cases. Adapt it in problem.md for the class; it is not an actual organization’s rule or research result.

供述：收件者圈出空白欄位，再請對方補
推論：具體欄位提示可能有幫助，尚待任務測試

exercise.environment: Use problem.md, a text editor and the synthetic role table. No actual participants or business data are required.
steps: List five responsibilities in the shared case and one question each role can best clarify.
Replace “Would you like AI to handle this automatically?” with one neutral question each for intake, review and management, adding follow-up questions about events.
Use a synthetic answer to record an account, inference, proposed requirement and pending decision. Ask a peer which part still lacks evidence.
exercise.expected: A role table, three interview questions and one proposed requirement with a synthetic source in problem.md.
exercise.check: Questions do not assume tools; records distinguish reported actions, designer interpretation and the confirming role, without presenting guesses as research.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic labels and revision history. Replace any actual names or nonpublic examples entered by mistake with codes and synthetic situations.

zh.prompt: 誰應列入利害關係人盤點？
options: 只有每天點表單的人
只有出資主管
會定義規則、接收結果、受影響或負責維運的人，也需依問題納入
只有 Agent 建議的人
rationales: 直接使用者很重要，但不是全部受影響者。
主管不能代替每個工作位置的證據。
盤點依任務與影響範圍進行，再選適合的研究對象。
模型可協助列候選，仍需人類確認實際工作關係。

en.prompt: Who belongs in the stakeholder inventory?
options: Only people who use the form daily.
Only the funding supervisor.
Include people who define rules, receive outcomes, are affected or operate the service, according to the research question.
Only people suggested by the agent.
rationales: Direct users matter but are not all affected parties.
A supervisor cannot supply evidence from every work position.
Identify roles from the task and its impact, then select relevant research participants.
A model can suggest candidates; people must confirm actual work relationships.

zh.prompt: 哪個問題最適合找出現況困難？
options: 上一次交接缺件時，你先做了什麼？接著誰接手？
你同意加 AI 一定更快嗎？
是不是你不熟系統才填錯？
要不要一次把所有功能做好？
rationales: 具體事件與中立追問能揭露流程與責任。
預設了解法與效果。
先給原因會抑制其他解釋。
偏向解法與範圍選擇，尚未理解工作。

en.prompt: Which question best explores current difficulties?
options: The last time you handed over incomplete material, what did you do first and who took over next?
Do you agree that AI must make this faster?
Did you enter it incorrectly because you do not understand the system?
Should we build every feature at once?
rationales: A concrete event and neutral follow-up reveal flow and responsibility.
This assumes a solution and effect.
Supplying a cause first discourages other explanations.
This jumps to solutions and scope before understanding the work.

zh.prompt: 兩個角色對必填規則說法不同，下一步應如何處理？
options: 採用票數較多的一方
請模型自行決定
默默把兩種說法都做成可切換設定
保留適用情境與衝突，找規則負責角色確認，再補案例
rationales: 票數不能單獨決定規則。
模型沒有這項業務決策權。
增加選項可能隱藏尚未解決的責任與不一致。
記錄與確認讓規則可追溯，也能發現是否只是不同階段。

en.prompt: Two roles disagree about a required-field rule. What comes next?
options: Choose the view with more votes.
Let the model decide.
Quietly implement both as switchable settings.
Retain contexts and the conflict, ask the rule-owning role to confirm and add cases.
rationales: Votes alone do not determine the rule.
The model has no authority over this business decision.
Extra settings may hide unresolved responsibility and inconsistency.
Recording and confirmation make the rule traceable and may reveal different stages.
